WEDGE-RELEASE PROTOCOL, the first recovery in the helm, designed against the correction stream (a terrain symptom of this build), not against the step. Suppressed only while the declared dig-step owns the stall (a dig inside the last 5 s). Every firing is logged with its trigger (windowDisp, stuckForMs) and the body's position/onGround before and after the cycle (dispCycle), returned on walkTo's result ({ok, wedge}) and kept at module level in the new declared prim wedgeStats(). what: lib/prims.js walkTo -> helm v3.5 (backup lib/prims.js.bak-helm35). Three coordinated changes over v3.4, answering traverse-verify-2's two measured mechanisms. (A) SINGLE STALL OWNERSHIP (arbiter): the four episodic recoveries (wedge-release, dig-step, guarded lateral probe, backoff+settle) are granted a stall ONE AT A TIME by an arbiter inside walkTo; the owner holds the stall until it resolves (progress) or exhausts (its full cycle budget: wedge = 3 cycles + long backoff + final cycle; dig = one episode + a 5 s conversion window; probe = one episode; backoff = one episode + a 3 s conversion window); while an owner holds, the other episodic recoveries are not evaluated for movement AT ALL - the v3.4 duel (the backoff's limit oscillation masking the wedge trigger) is impossible by construction, not tuning. Priority wedge -> dig -> probe -> backoff; fairness: an exhausted recovery cannot be re-granted until another recovery has owned the stall since, or 10 s pass. Jump pulses (momentum step-up, stall bursts) are classified DRIVE, not recovery - they never displace the body horizontally - and run only in unowned time or inside the current owner's drive window. Grants/releases are logged in the walk result ({arbiter}) and in the new declared prim arbiterStats(). (B) PROGRESS-KEYED TRIGGER: the stall statistic is distance-to-current-waypoint - a stall is declared when the target distance fails to improve by >= 0.2 blocks over a 3 s window while forward intent is held; oscillation toward/away from a face nets ~zero progress and cannot mask the trigger (v3.4 keyed on raw displacement, which friendly fire faked). Wedge cycle records now carry windowProg (the window's progress deficit) in place of windowDisp. (C) FACE-KEYED JUMP TIMING: the wedge cycle's forward+jump phase drives forward WITHOUT the jump, polling the new frontFaceDist front-row column scan at 40 ms, and starts the jump when the face is ~0.8-1.0 blocks ahead, so the apex carries the body onto the step; a face already at contact distance starts the jump at once; if no face enters scan range within 350 ms the cycle falls back to the v3.4 hold timing; the face distance at every jump start is logged (faceDistAtJump, jumpKeyed). frontFaceDist geometry was unit-verified offline against the gate-survey z=-84 row profile (6/6 cases: distances 1.5 / 0.01 / 2.2 at the x54 face from three stands, null on the flat plateau, 0.2 westward). Dig-step semantics UNCHANGED (clean +1s never dug; extending the allowance remains the OWNER's decision, not taken). Declared in the prim: surface (walkTo v3.5 + arbiterStats + wedgeStats lines) and the README build log.
